notes: Physical I/O compiled from QSC's official TouchMix Series Spec Sheet (March 2024 PDF) plus the TouchMix-30 Pro User Manual rear-panel description (via ManualsLib). Input/output "Total" figures in QSC's spec table (32 in / 16 out) count logical mixer channels, not physical rear-panel jacks, so this port list enumerates actual physical connectors instead: Mic/Line 1-20 (XLR), Mic/Line 21-24 (XLR/TRS combo), 3 stereo TRS input pairs (Line 25/26, 27/28, 29/30 — note 29/30 is duplicated on a top-panel 1/8" TRS jack per QSC's own FAQ, not an additional rear jack), Talkback XLR, Main L/R XLR out, Monitor L/R XLR out, 14x Aux XLR outs, 2x stereo IEM TRS outs (tapped from Aux 11/12 and 13/14), 1x stereo Cue/headphone TRS out, 2x USB-A (one is USB 3.0 for multitrack recording/storage, the other USB-A port version not separately specified — treated as USB 2.0 for MP3/Wi-Fi-dongle use per common configuration), 1x USB-B (DAW interface, 32x32), 1x RJ45 (for external Wi-Fi router, not a native Ethernet data port), and the AC power inlet which multiple retailer/parts sources confirm is an IEC C13/C14 detachable-cord inlet (85W, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz) rather than a captive cord. A Kensington-style security slot exists but is not a signal/power port so it is omitted. Grades: RJ45 has no stated Ethernet speed in QSC literature (it exists solely to attach a Wi-Fi router, so no eth-* grade is asserted). USB ports have no stated USB version except the "USB 3.0 Type A" callout on one USB-A port per the manual; the second USB-A and the USB-B port versions are not explicitly stated by QSC and are left ungraded to avoid asserting an unconfirmed spec.

ports.name: Mic/Line 1-20
ports.note: 20x individual balanced XLR female mic/line inputs, 48V phantom switchable

ports.name: Mic/Line 21-24
ports.note: 4x combo XLR/TRS female inputs, 48V phantom switchable

ports.name: Line In 29/30
ports.note: Stereo balanced 1/4" TRS pair; also mirrored on a top-panel 1/8" (3.5mm) stereo jack, not a separate rear connector

ports.name: Aux 1-14
ports.note: 14x individual balanced XLR male line-level aux outputs; pairs may be linked for stereo/IEM use

ports.name: In-Ear Monitor (Aux 11/12)
ports.note: Stereo TRS output tapped from Aux 11/12, min. 16 ohm load

ports.name: In-Ear Monitor (Aux 13/14)
ports.note: Stereo TRS output tapped from Aux 13/14, min. 16 ohm load

ports.name: Cue
ports.note: Stereo TRS, line or headphone use, min. 16 ohm load

ports.name: USB (Storage)
ports.note: USB 3.0 Type A per user manual, for USB storage drive (multitrack record/playback) and firmware updates

ports.name: USB (Wi-Fi/MP3)
ports.note: Second USB Type A connector; version not separately specified by QSC (used for USB Wi-Fi adaptor or MP3 media)

ports.name: USB (DAW)
ports.note: USB Type B, 32x32 DAW interface for Mac OS/Windows

ports.name: Network
ports.note: RJ-45 port for connecting an external Wi-Fi router; not a general Ethernet data port and no speed grade is published

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC C14 inlet accepting detachable IEC C13 power cord; 85W, 100-240VAC, 50/60Hz per QSC spec sheet and confirmed IEC C13/NEMA 5-15P cord by third-party parts listings
